config.amendment: docs/SPEC.md, D10 canonical amendment (owner, 2026-09-12), the nineteen Fable addenda, and the reviewer decisions after dispatch 1
config.label: PONS MEMECOIN REPLAY ON A BOUNDED GENUINE COLLECTION
config.not_a_prediction_test: no predictive evaluation is designed for D10. There is no probe grid, no label, no AUC and no holdout in this wave, and conclusion 4 of amendment section 13 therefore reads 'not tested'.

modes.REPLAY_PAPER: chronological recorded Pons events on a virtual 30-second clock
modes.LIVE_PAPER: newly received Pons events on the wall clock — dispatch 3

learning_modes.FROZEN: weights do not move; settlements are counted SETTLED_FROZEN

config.horizon_note: fifteen minutes is a product-test setting, not a scientifically optimal memecoin horizon, and IBM's 90 minutes is not carried over. No other horizon is tried.
config.latency_rule: a decision at cutoff t fills at the reconstructed state of the first block whose timestamp is at or after t + 2 s; the exit uses the same rule at entry_fill_time + 900 s
config.exit_policy_rule: a decoded SELL while holding is refused by the execution policy with RejectReason.FIXED_HOLD and closes nothing; the position closes only at the declared horizon, labelled CloseReason.POLICY_CLOSE_FIXED_HOLD

gas.source: donor calibration medians over 40 buy and 40 sell receipts, ~/Documentos/PONS/artifacts/curve-simulation/gas.json sha256 23e3df06cc2a986734b7ca661107d0397a15b5f77ff6db0e30ac7d2d1b726daf, recorded in experiments/d10/REUSE.md by dispatch 1
gas.approval_is_an_assumption: the approval leg is a 60,000-gas assumption at the same gas price, not a receipt, and is charged once per episode on the exit
gas.charged: into Fill.fee on each leg, so net = quote_out - spent - gas

curve_costs: snipe tax, capped and decaying over the first 5 s
cost_model.into_fees: the three curve costs plus the gas of that leg
cost_model.into_slippage: the price impact of our own size: the gap between the pre-trade marginal price and the price actually achieved
cost_model.identity: gross_reference_pnl - slippage - fees = net_pnl and net_pnl = gross_pnl - fees both hold, so flytrade.execution.Account's existing invariant tests still bite

features.windows_clipped_to_launch: ret_w = log(p(cutoff) / p(max(cutoff - w, launch))) and drawdown_5m maxes since max(cutoff - 5 min, launch): a token younger than the window measures since its launch, it is not zeroed
features.single_signed_note: three of the eight features never change sign, so one glomerulus of each of those pairs only ever receives the carrier. Declared, not hidden.
features.normalisation: tanh(raw / scale), fixed declared scales, never refitted
features.scale_rule: p90(|x|) rounded to two significant figures over the tokens launched in the first 60 minutes of the backfill window, at 30-second grid points, age >= 60 s and >= 3 trades; age is the declared constant 600 s
features.supersedes: experiments/d10/feature_scales.json, dispatch 1, which zeroed windows predating the launch on a dataset whose tokens live ~62 s

rules: deployment pons-v2
quote asset native ETH
observation usable: age >= 60 s, >= 3 trades, consistent state
curve not completed at the cutoff
sellableTokens > 0 and realQuoteReserve > 0
the paper buy of 0.01 ETH would not exhaust the curve
cutoff + 2 s + 900 s lies inside the token's coverage
admission.launch_admission_window: launches in the first 120 minutes of the window only
admission.rotation: round-robin: rounds since last presentation descending, then launch block, then launch log index, then curve address. Blind to price, volume, flow, outcome and ticker.
admission.while_holding: only the held token is presented, as D5-D9(b) do; the ROUND record still carries the tick's full admitted / rotated tallies

clean_reference_checkpoint.note: amendment section 3: the Pons experiment starts from the declared clean reference checkpoint, never from the IBM-trained checkpoint

readout.why: the seed schedule must not change because the weights differ, so the LEARN branch and the FROZEN branch draw the same Poisson stream for the same observation; order and metadata invariance then hold by construction, because observation_id is a content hash and stable_id is assigned at registration and never from the address spelling
readout.aggregation: mean of per-neuron rates over the k replicates, decoder applied once
readout.decoder: flytrade.decoder.ActionDecoder at the stored k=8 baseline and margin

reinforcement.attributed_to: the entry decision's stored k=8 eligibility trace set, by episode id
reinforcement.mapping: valence is the sign of the settled net outcome and amount is min(|net_pnl / notional| / reinforce_full_scale, reinforce_cap) with reinforce_full_scale = 0.01 and reinforce_cap = 1.0 — flytrade.execution.ExecutionPolicy.reinforcement, unchanged, with no new constant added by this wave
reinforcement.consequence_declared_before_the_run: a memecoin's fifteen-minute return on a 0.01 ETH notional will usually exceed 1 %, so amount will usually saturate at the cap. That is a consequence of reusing the existing rule and is recorded here rather than fixed by inventing a Pons scale.

settlement.rule: a block is confirmed when it is at least confirm_depth behind head and, since the endpoint answers the safe tag, also at or below safe
settlement.outcome_requires: the entry-fill block and the exit block both confirmed
settlement.until_then: PENDING_CONFIRMATION, retried on later ticks, never a loss

unresolved_reasons.ROUTE_TRANSITION: the curve completed onto the unsupported Uniswap V4 route before the horizon: the exposure is retained, nothing settles and nothing is taught. It is neither a loss nor a win.
unresolved_reasons.COVERAGE: the data does not reach the horizon block
unresolved_reasons.PENDING_CONFIRMATION: the blocks are not confirmed yet
unresolved_reasons.END_OF_DATA: the window ended with the position still open

settlement.replay_confirmation: evaluated against the head the collection recorded. The window ends at the safe block, so every block in it satisfies both rules and the check is exercised rather than skipped.

budgets.replay_run_cost_note: the replay run opens no socket, by construction
budgets.live_cap: 60 minutes wall clock or 3000 requests, whichever first (dispatch 3)
budgets.header_grid_rule: one header per 100 blocks plus each tick's latest; timestamps between anchors are linearly interpolated and carry block_timestamp_interpolated with that precision

window.rule: the N minutes of blocks ending at the safe block recorded by verification.json, block count from the measured interval

validation_dataset_not_used_for_the_run.label: d10-replay-v1
validation_dataset_not_used_for_the_run.why: it covers ~62 s per token, so a 15-minute horizon admits nothing on it. Reviewer decision 1 keeps it as validation evidence and probe material.

expected_activity_before_the_run.arithmetic: 135 minutes at a 30-second cadence is 270 ticks; one position at a time, each locking 900 s = 30 ticks, gives at most 9 episodes in the window, and admission is closed after minute 120.
expected_activity_before_the_run.expected_fewer_because: an entry also needs a decoded BUY, and a curve that completes before the horizon settles nothing
expected_activity_before_the_run.zero_is_admissible: zero episodes is an admissible result to be reported as such. Nothing — gain, thresholds, scales, admission — is touched to produce activity.

branches.learning: LEARN, from the clean reference checkpoint, strict chronological order over the window, one brain carried through
branches.frozen_reference: FROZEN, the same data and the same seeds from the same clean checkpoint: the mechanical control, not a scientific comparison. Its end digest must equal its start digest and its settlements must all count SETTLED_FROZEN with credit accepted 0.

runs.determinism: the learning branch is executed a second time and must reproduce the first bit for bit, after removing the two fields a second process cannot reproduce by construction: the wall-clock 't' stamped on every event line and the absolute checkpoint path. Every other byte, and the final state digest, must be identical.
runs.restart_rule: after the first settled episode the learning branch destroys its in-memory gains, rebuilds the journal and recovers from the checkpoint and the log; the run is refused unless the gains are restored exactly

frozen_and_not_decided_by_this_run: the encoder coding rule, its carrier, budget and bounds
MBON membership and the decoder formula, its sign and THETA_SD = 1.0
one normalised learning update per settled outcome
experiments/d5 .. d9b and every committed IBM artifact

baseline.distribution: the k-presentation aggregate raw valence V_raw = mean(approach) - mean(avoid) at the neutral reference, one sample per BATCH, sample standard deviation with ddof=1 - never the standard error of that mean

readout.aggregation: mean of per-neuron rates, decoder applied once
readout.why: amendment section 6: the stimulus realisation must not change because the weights differ
